taskCall.context:
# Goal
Kake round 42, wave 1: test whether a counter separates a real speed-up of a URL check from cheaper tools, before the round's claim is frozen; plus the build (unscored), source opening, record repairs and reviews. The L1 (agent id KakeR42) is the only integrator and scorer; you are one leaf seat. Lane repo: /home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/kake-shokunin (tip d1c3f372b59fd3247e9f72b4a0b9a45cf19ba83c). Lane axes: operability and freshness. This is ordinary software testing of a local, offline, network-free command-line tool that audits sitemap XML files.

# The planned claim (read /home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/kake-shokunin/SCORECARD.md section "Round 42 — C1 counter candidate")
`/home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/kake-shokunin/scripts/sitemap_audit.py` (the round-41 tool, sha256 50287ac6…, copy /fast/scratch/hyaku/kake-r42/shared/tip41.py) judges URLs with a regular expression `_URI_RE` (lines 67-86) before `urlsplit`. That check is slow on long adversarial values (backtracking). C1: a rewritten check keeps EVERY judgment of the round-41 tool and costs at most 2.0 times the round-40 tool's CPU time (copy /fast/scratch/hyaku/kake-r42/shared/base40.py, sha256 4de35f8c…) on five input shapes. Candidate counter: /home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/kake-shokunin/.ufo/waves/round-42/c42_count.py (sha256 7bfc32c5…). Predicate: `met: the tool's exit code and output equal the round-41 tool's on every generated run, and its median CPU time on each of the five timing shapes is at most 2.0 times the round-40 tool's`. Equality runs A/B/C and timing shapes T1–T5 are generated per run from a seed; read the counter's docstring. The round-41 tool itself scores T1 ≈5.4, T5 ≈9 (not met); the round-40 tool fails equality (3/8).

A "control" is a tool built to SKIP part of the claimed work: it judges some value differently from the round-41 tool, or it lowers the measured CPU without doing the work (hiding CPU, caching, keying on ids/shapes/labels, reading outside its case directory). If any control meets the predicate, the counter is too weak and the claim is redesigned or declared exploratory — so a control that meets is a valuable finding, not a failure. A tool whose judgments equal the round-41 tool's on every value, however written, is NOT a control. If your tool meets, also give a witness value on which it differs from tip41 (that is what makes it a control).

# Scoring a tool (control and mutant seats)
`timeout 900 prlimit --as=8000000000 -- python3 -B /home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/kake-shokunin/.ufo/waves/round-42/c42_count.py --root /home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/kake-shokunin --tool-file <your tool> --label <YourName>-<suffix> --seed <N> --out /fast/scratch/hyaku/kake-r42w1/<YourName>/<suffix>.json` — exit 0 met, 1 not met, 2 cannot evaluate; about 50-90 s per run, single core. Run at most 3 counter processes at once. The receipt lists `equalRuns`, per-run `equal`/`candRepsEqual`, `ratios` and CPU samples. The L1 re-scores every tool that meets. Build seats (ExecBuild*) never run the counter.

# Bounds
- You are a leaf: no subagents, no swarm, no verdict on the round.
- Your ONLY write paths are your sandbox /fast/scratch/hyaku/kake-r42w1/<YourName>/ and your report file. Never mutate the fleet repo (/home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin), sibling lanes, the lane jj state, the lane Git index or any lane file other than your report. Never edit files under /fast/scratch/hyaku/kake-r42/shared or /home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/kake-shokunin/.ufo/waves/round-42 (except your report).
- Never run git add/commit/stash/checkout/reset/pull/push or any mutating jj command in /home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/kake-shokunin; read-only git is fine. Never run jj at /home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin. If you need a clone: `git clone -q /home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/kake-shokunin /fast/scratch/hyaku/kake-r42w1/<YourName>/clone` after unsetting GIT_DIR, GIT_WORK_TREE and GIT_INDEX_FILE.
- Cap every run with `timeout` (≤900 s), ≤8 parallel processes, `prlimit --as=8000000000`; bound every file you write (≤300 MB per seat; never append in a loop to a file Python imports; never point a log at sitecustomize.py or a .pth); kill every process tree you start before returning. Never run `du` or `find` over /fast/scratch as a whole.
- Network: only URLs your item names, GET only. Never request the operator's properties (ds4cc.com, app.ds4cc.com, operator *.onrender.com hosts, *.kimi.page, *.kimi.pro, veigapunk.github.io, any host in /home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/kake-shokunin/corpus/knowledge/freshness-pins.json).
- Every `Report:` trailer path is relative to /home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/kake-shokunin — write it at /home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/kake-shokunin/<that path>.
- Tooling authorization (operator, 2026-10-19): you and every seat may install or upgrade tools that help the task — read /home/vgpnk/.omp/agent/RULES.md first (official channels; record tool, version, channel and reason in your report). All pacman transactions are PAUSED host-wide (orchestrator ruling 2026-10-20): install via uv tool, npx or an official binary in ~/.local/bin; never pacman -S, -Sy, -Syu, -U or -R, no downgrade, no service restart.
- A provider safety or policy refusal or an automatic model switch ends your item: a one-line report saying so; do not rephrase. Message only agent://KakeR42 for blockers; never agent://all. Plain English.

# Result
Report under 60 lines: what you built or checked, exact commands with exit codes, tool paths with sha256, counter results (equalRuns, ratios, met) for every tool you scored, findings with path:line, and per checked statement: holds / overstated / wrong. An unrun check has not passed. Time box: 30 minutes; a partial report (first line `PARTIAL:`) beats none.
